name: Manectric

attacks.name: Flash
attacks.text: During your opponent’s next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn’t happen.

flavor:
It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so
it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with
electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
